# Octa Devs

> An app development studio founded by Aarav Sharma and Akshansh Sinha,
> building mobile and web products end to end — from strategy and interface
> design through launch. Building since 2026. Based in India.

Octa Devs takes products from idea to store listing: native and cross-platform
mobile apps, web platforms and dashboards, product design, and MVPs built to
validate quickly and scale afterwards. Work is handled directly by the
founders rather than routed through account layers.

## Services

- **Mobile App Development** — iOS and Android, React Native, App Store launch.
- **Web App Development** — product platforms, dashboards, scalable systems.
- **UI/UX Design** — product strategy, user flows, interface design.
- **MVP Development** — rapid prototyping, validation, growth-ready foundations.

## Pages

- [Home](https://octadevs.fun/): Studio overview, services, team, and contact.
- [Work](https://octadevs.fun/work): Project portfolio, including shipped and upcoming work.

- [Privacy Policy](https://octadevs.fun/privacy): How data is collected, processed, and protected.
- [Terms of Service](https://octadevs.fun/terms): Terms governing the website and engineering services.

New project enquiries go through the contact form on the home page, which
reaches the team directly.

## Notes for automated readers

- Canonical URLs are extensionless; `/page.html` permanently redirects to `/page`.
- `/admin` is a private console with no public content and is disallowed in robots.txt.
- Team members and portfolio entries are served dynamically from `/api/team`
  and `/api/projects`, so they may not appear in a static fetch of the HTML.
